title: ICJF Conferences

items.html: November 6-7, 2025, The 5th Biennial Conference on Religion and Politics, Supreme Guarantee against All Abuses of Power?, Question of God and Existence of Politics, In Memory of John Paul II, co-organized and co-sponsored as Subsidium-ICJF with organizers: The Institute of Political Science and Public Administration of the Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University in Warsaw, Ave Maria School of Law, Naples, Florida, USA, Collegium Interethnicum (Poland), in Warsaw, Poland.

September 25-27, 2025, Truth, Freedom of Speech, and Modern-day Censorship, co-sponsored as Subsidium-ICJF with Ralston College, The Ruth Institute, Ave Maria School of Law, Center for Family and Human Rights (C-Fam), held in Washington, D.C.

July 13-18, 2025, First World Congress of the Ius Naturalis Societas: Natural Law and Human Rights co-sponsored as Subsidium-ICJF with the organizer: Ius Naturalis Societas held at the Colegio Mayor San Paolo, Madrid, Spain.

April 30 -May 05, 2025, Natural Law Summer School: Justice and Solidarity co-sponsored as Subsidium-ICJF with the organizers: The Department of Philosophy of Law and Legal Ethics, and The Department of Roman Law and Its Centre For Law and Religious Freedom at the Jagiellonian University in Kraków, Poland.

October 24-26, 2024, Man and Woman in the Order of Creation co-sponsored with the Office of the President of Steubenville University, The Department of Theology of Steubenville University, Ethics and Public Policy Center, and The Mary Elizabeth Charitable Trust, at the University of Steubenville, Ohio.

June 20-22, 2024 Gender Ideology and Pastoral Care: Towards the Creation of A New Pastoral Handbook for Clergy and Ministry Leaders on Questions Related to Gender Ideology, co-sponsored with Ethics and Public Policy Center, Ave Maria School of Law, and the Catholic Information Center, Washington, D.C.

November 30 – 1 December 2023: co-sponsor of the 4th Biennial International Conference on Religion and Politics: A New, Even More Brave World… The Hope of Faith and the Hope of Politics. In Memory of Pope Benedict XVI, International Political Science Association, Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University in Warsaw, Poland.

16 September 2023: International Expert Meeting (on-line): Reflections on key themes in the working document for the Synod on Synodality, namely the Instrumentum Laboris of the 16th Ordinary Assembly of the Synod of Bishops (May 29).

8-10 December 2022: International Expert Meeting: A Response to the Pontifical Academy for Life’s Publication: Etica teologica della Vita. Scritture, tradizione, sfide pratiche (live streamed event) Rome, Italy, Co-sponsored by Ave Maria School of Law, Ave Maria University, Ethics for Public Policy Center, Person & Identity Project.
24-25 June 2022: International Expert Meeting: Aquinas, Law & Politics in Times of COVID, Rome, Italy
3 December 2021: On-line International Expert Meeting on The Relevance of Saint Joseph for Our Times.
28, 29. 30 October 2021: On-line International Expert Meeting on Rescuing Girls of Religious Minorities from Sexual Enslavement
8-9, 15-16 January 2021: On-line International Expert Meeting on Clerical Sexual Misconduct: A Foundational Conversation.

5-7 March 2020: International Expert Meeting on The Persecution and Genocide of Christians in Sub-Saharan Africa co-sponsored by Ave Maria School of Law and the Hudson Institute’s Center for Religious Freedom and the Aid to the Church in Need, held at Ave Maria School of Law, Naples, Florida
24-26 September 2018: International Expert Meeting on Clerical Sexual Misconduct with Males held at Ave Maria School of Law, in Naples, Florida

2-4 July 2018: International Expert Meeting on Human Rights: Evaluation and Future Direction co-sponsored by Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University, President of the Personal Data Protection Office, The University of Warsaw, Formerly ICOLF, and the Honorary Patronage of the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Poland, held at Cardinal Stefan Wyszynski University, in Warsaw.

3-4 December 2017: International Expert Meeting on The UN Global Compacts on Migrants and Refugees co-sponsored by Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University, held at Cardinal Stefan Wyszyński University, in Warsaw.
4-6 February 2016: International Expert Meeting on The Persecution and Genocide of Christians in the Middle East held at Ave Maria School of Law, in Naples, Florida.
19-21 February 2015: International Expert Meeting on Equality and Non-discrimination: Catholic Roots, Current Challenges held at Ave Maria School of Law, in Naples, Florida.
